Gyeonggi Province (경기도) — Südkorea Reiseführer: Sehenswürdigkeiten, Anreise & Spezialitäten

Suwon Hwaseong Fortress (UNESCO), DMZ & Panmunjom (Paju), Korean Folk Village (Yongin), Gapyeong & Nami Island gateway. Directly integrated with Seoul Metropolitan Subway, GTX high-speed commuter rail, and KTX via Suwon & Gwangmyeong.

Region / KantonGyeonggi Province (경기도)
VerkehrsknotenpunktSuwon Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
Alle Städte394

Anreise & Nahverkehr

Directly integrated with Seoul Metropolitan Subway, GTX high-speed commuter rail, and KTX via Suwon & Gwangmyeong.

Lokale Küche & Spezialitäten

  • Suwon Wang Galbi (marinated beef ribs)
  • Icheon rice feast (Hanjeongsik)
  • Uijeongbu Budae-jjigae
  • Paju soybean dishes
